description: This file defines a handler class for creating code values within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is annotated as a service for processing 'CREATE' commands on 'CODEVALUE' entities.

classes.name: CreateCodeValueCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for handling create commands for code values in the system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the processing of the JSON command to create a new code value by delegating to the write platform service.
